summary: Built a 4-node MariaDB Galera cluster on RHEL9 nodes node1-node4. Bootstrapped a 3-node cluster on node1/node2/node3 (mariadb-server-galera 10.5.29 from RHEL AppStream), created application database appdb.orders with data, then added node4 as a fourth member which received the existing dataset via rsync SST and began accepting writes like the other members. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot IDs and cluster health on all 4 nodes, then restarted node4, node3, node2, and node1 one at a time (preserving 3-of-4 quorum throughout), confirming a changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery (wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced, wsrep_ready=ON, appdb.orders intact) after each. Verified with a final cross-node write/read check post-restart-cycle.
actions_performed: Checked pre-existing state on all 4 nodes (no MariaDB installed anywhere)
Installed mariadb-server + mariadb-server-galera on node1-4 via dnf
Opened firewalld ports 3306/4444/4567(tcp+udp)/4568 on all 4 nodes
Populated /etc/hosts with cluster hostnames on all nodes
Generated SST/root secrets on node1 and distributed via SSH (cluster keypair) to node2-4 without printing secret values
Bootstrapped cluster via galera_new_cluster on node1; started mariadb normally on node2 and node3 (joined, cluster_size 3, Synced)
Secured root account (ALTER USER, replicated cluster-wide via TOI) and removed anonymous/test artifacts
Created appdb.orders table and inserted rows from node1; verified replication to node2/node3 and multi-master write from node3
Updated wsrep_cluster_address to include node4 on node1-3; wrote node4 galera.cnf; installed, enabled, started mariadb on node4
Verified node4 joined via SST with cluster_size=4, Synced, full existing dataset, and accepted a new write that propagated to node1-3
Captured baseline boot_id and health on all 4 nodes

Sequentially restarted node4, node3, node2, node1 via systemctl reboot (one at a time, quorum preserved), polled each until exec available again, confirmed changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery after each
Performed a final post-restart-cycle write on node1 and confirmed propagation to node2/node3/node4

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster running on node1-3 holding application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (size 1, Synced); node2 and node3 joined sequentially reaching cluster_size 3; appdb.orders created and written on node1, confirmed replicated to node2 and node3, and node3 wrote successfully too (multi-master).

evidence.requirement: node4 added as 4th member, carries existing data
evidence.summary: node4 started mariadb, joined via SST, wsrep_cluster_size=4/Synced/ready=ON on node4, and appdb.orders SELECT on node4 shows the pre-existing rows (widget-a/b/c, widget-from-node3); node1 confirms wsrep_incoming_addresses lists all 4 IPs.

evidence.requirement: node4 accepts writes like other members
evidence.summary: Inserted 'widget-from-node4' directly on node4; verified the row appears on node1, node2, and node3.

evidence.requirement: Baseline boot identity and health before restarts (all nodes)
evidence.summary: Captured /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id for node1-4 prior to any restart, establishing the pre-restart identity baseline.

evidence.requirement: node4 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 583ddd53... to 37f4f378...; mariadb active; wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced, ready=ON, orders COUNT=5 after rejoin.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from c2f29441... to b89477f9...; mariadb active; cluster_size=4, Synced, ready=ON, orders COUNT=5.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 6aa805ba... to cba54f9c...; mariadb active; cluster_size=4, Synced, ready=ON, orders COUNT=5.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 377b5195... to 9e1354ed...; mariadb active; cluster_size=4, Synced, ready=ON, orders COUNT=5.

evidence.requirement: Full cluster health/write-path verified after complete restart cycle of all 4 nodes
evidence.summary: Post-restart-cycle write 'post-restart-check' inserted on node1 and confirmed present via COUNT query on node2, node3, and node4.
